style: A refined black event poster centered on thin, softly shaded three-dimensional monoline HUMAN rails. Rounded corners, modest depth, a fixed camera and ample negative space. A smaller AI is a waypoint below the main word. A single identifiable marble makes a continuous return journey. Restrained SOYLAB color accents; no glow, chunky letters, edge-to-edge typography, people illustrations or stock artwork.

customize.shot_brief: From the first frame, a readable HUMAN sculpture and event information already form a complete poster. One small marble leaves its HUMAN origin, follows a continuous route through a smaller AI, and returns to the same origin without changing color. A single brief contour compression marks the return, then the composition settles into a clear final poster. The event message is that AI brings people back to people.

original_3d_code.description: Project-local procedural letter rails, route, marble, shading and deterministic time-driven state; independently authored from the approved direction. Existing A/C/B scenes are not edited.

queries: thin three-dimensional letter rails with one marble traveling from HUMAN through AI and returning
short concentric outline compression for a single landing emphasis with a fixed camera
catalog_review.decision: No optional block is named: this records the already approved original 3D implementation. Search results such as card rails, type reveals, camera-follow captions and ripple transitions are not substituted for the commissioned HUMAN return scene.

layout.bounds_requirement: HUMAN, AI, marble route, Korean information and final CTA must remain readable without collisions or clipping at both canvas sizes.

marble.identity: Keep the same visible color throughout departure, AI passage and return
marble.route: HUMAN origin -> smaller AI waypoint -> the same HUMAN origin
marble.continuity: No teleportation, duplication or unexplained disappearance
marble.ai_passage_timing_status: Confirmed from scene.js: aiRoute is active from 3.6 to 4.5 seconds; 3.9 seconds is the AI proof sample.

return_emphasis.action: Compress surrounding contour depth toward HUMAN once, then remove the extra contours
constraints: Restore the clean sculpture by 6.4 seconds

delivery.after_final_hold: The live web version may continue subtle motion of the same small marble while keeping the poster stable; encoded duration remains exactly 9 seconds.
delivery.role: Reusable HUMAN component. This nine-second plan is retained as a component reference, not the complete event-header delivery. The complete C sequence is to be assembled separately in concept-c-integrated.

verification.ai_sample_note: The 3.9-second proof sample falls within the confirmed scene.js AI passage range of 3.6–4.5 seconds.
